newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Key Technology started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Key Technology started.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said it started coverage of Key Technology Inc with a buy rating. -- In a release dated November 15, analyst Reid Dabney said the company has an estimated annual growth rate of 20 percent to 25 percent, gross margins exceeding 40 percent and a 12- to 18-month price target of $35 based on a $1.57 fiscal 1998 earnings estimate. -- Key Technology makes automated food processing systems and uses proprietary automated vision inspection technology. -- Key Technology shares were trading at 24-3/4, off 3/8.
